Original title and connector crops verify PARALLEL ADDER BIT 52, date 08-14-69, machine 7201-02, LOG 153, FRAME 02, part 2584559, IBM CORP., BLK., BP and all eight connector-table strings. The +BIT CARRY 52 branch on output-upper-original.png and BIT-CARRY52-ref-6x-original.png reads AP617: the digit after 6 has a straight stem and foot. It differs from the AP637 reference on the separate top +BIT TRANSMIT 52 line in top-right-original.png, whose 3 has two right lobes. Source AP617 is retained.

Same-TIFF AG-AQ-AL-AR-AS-functions-original.png compares the bank2 AG2B and bank4 AQ4B open-top U glyphs directly with closed O glyphs on AL, AR and AS. AG and AQ are printed UR, not OR; the literal source functions are retained.

The AU output stem crosses that row35 lead at a plain crossing and continues to AT.J10 and BB.J10; AS is owned by AL, not AU. SCAN52-diamond-to-AW-original.png shows SCAN OUT52 branching from its lower printed diamond to AW.D12, while BF.D12 remains on the same scan trunk. CLOCKP3-AW-AX-gap-original.png shows separate CLOCK P3 stem starting at AX.2 and a blank gap between AW.D12 and AX.2. The first clock label has the original hollow-diamond separator. These source-specific owners and gaps are retained in native-terminal-resolution.json and the graph.
